text:
alex-support: Hey team — multiple customers on Dedicated (us-east-1a pool) reporting 429s + big tail latency starting ~10:14 UTC. Tenant id: tenant-42. Any known incidents?
carla-customer-success: Which endpoints are failing? customer says both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings getting 429s and occasional 500s.
alex-support: Repro curl they sent:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
```
Response headers include: `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-tenant-quota: 5` (weird).
bob-sre: Looking at infra: I can see sustained 10–15 rps from tenant-42 hitting dedicated-us-east-1a-pool-3 around 10:12–10:20. Autoscaler logs show repeated "do_not_scale" with reason `tenant_quota_exceeded`. Snippet from autoscaler: 
```
[2026-02-18T10:16:02Z] scale_decision id=pool-3 reason=do_not_scale tenant=tenant-42 current_rps=12 tenant_quota_rps=5
[2026-02-18T10:16:02Z] action=none msg=quota_gate triggered
```
bob-sre: TL;DR autoscaler refuses to add nodes because per-tenant quota is configured too low — looks like a policy gate: we won't scale beyond tenant's quota to avoid noisy neighbor.
derek-eng: Confirmed — I just reviewed config-management PR 489 that rolled a change to default per-tenant quota. A bad default (5 rps) got applied to new tenants and some existing ones through a config migration.
carla-customer-success: This tenant has a Dedicated reserved contract; billing/plan should allow higher throughput. Customer upset.
alex-support: Escalating to Eng for immediate mitigation. Any quick fixes we can do without a deploy?
bob-sre: We can manually bump tenant quota with admin tools: `rbac-admin set-tenant-quota tenant-42 --rps 50`. Doing that now.
deploy-bot: "admin-change: set-tenant-quota tenant-42 50 by bob-sre at 2026-02-18T10:23:14Z"
bob-sre: Done — I see the 429s stop for the test requests, latency back to normal. I'll keep watch.
derek-eng: I'll revert the bad migration and push a validation that prevents default < 20 rps for Dedicated tenants. Preparing patch (#492).
alex-support: Customer notified that we applied a temporary quota increase and are rolling a fix, they asked for ETA on permanent fix.
carla-customer-success: Customer happy to have mitigation but wants formal postmortem and assurance it won't recur.
bob-sre: Action items: 1) hotfix migration rollback (derek) 2) add validation in config service (derek) 3) add alert if autoscaler gate fires >5 times in 5m (bob) 4) verify quotas for all Dedicated tenants (alex)
derek-eng: Patch merged to staging, will promote to prod after one quick smoke test. ETA ~40m.
alex-support: Thanks — I'll create an official incident ticket and follow up with customer. :thumbsup:
bob-sre: Monitoring graph shows tenant-42 rps normalized after quota bump. Leaving on-watch for 30m.
carla-customer-success: Marking resolved for now once we confirm 30m stable; will request billing/plan audit to reconcile quota vs contract.
alex-support: Great. Closing thread after watch window.
